audit.why: 50.56% over 2041 games with a 7/10 difficulty reads as a skill lane, and the all-Aurora chart is defensible on range: Aurora pokes at 900 while Naafiri's W is 400 and Eviscerate 450, so every approach is a cooldown Aurora can count. Chart left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].why and phases[5].why are the generic Aurora template with 'his' for a female enemy, and neither names a Naafiri timer.
audit.why: At level 1 Naafiri has only Darkin Daggers (9/8.5/8/7.5/7s), and packmates only leap onto the first champion those daggers hit — that is the whole level-1 threat. At first item the punishable window is Eviscerate's 11s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Level 1 and First item rewritten to name Darkin Daggers and Eviscerate's 11s.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.carry says only 'she must come to you' and never states that The Call of the Pack (W) and Eviscerate (E) both make her untargetable through your commit.
audit.why: Riot's text flags W and E untargetable, and R untargetable on the dash. Aurora's burst pattern is Q into recast, so dumping it into an untargetable window is the losing line — this is the listed _missing interaction for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Hold burst until she reappears; spend it in the window after her R.

audit.why: breakdown.cooldowns carries real numbers: R 110/95/80, E 11s rank 1, W 26s, Aurora W 22s.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] tells you to 'add anti-heal early into her sustain', but Riot's Eviscerate text heals her PACKMATES, not Naafiri.
audit.why: The kit gives no self-heal on Naafiri, so I cannot verify that Grievous Wounds is the correct early buy here. Left the line alone rather than assert either way — recorded in notes.

edits.before: Q-poke and recast on his last-hits — the spirit-mark detonation chips harder than the lane expects.
edits.after: Q-poke and recast on her last-hits — at 1 she has only Darkin Daggers and the pack goes where they land.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the full Q-E-Q rotation chunks half bars. Force trades on his cooldown gaps.
edits.after: Luden's spike: the full Q-E-Q rotation chunks half bars. Trade while Eviscerate's 11s is down.

edits.before: Carry by spacing: her whole kit is 400-900 range and she must come to you, so hold W for the R and win the fight after it.
edits.after: Carry by spacing: W and Eviscerate both turn her untargetable, so hold your burst until she reappears and spend it after her R.

edits.before: She roams with the pack — a crashed wave and a ping beats it.
edits.after: Packmates follow her roam — crash, ping, then take plates.

notes: Left report[8]'s 'add anti-heal early into her sustain' untouched: Riot's Eviscerate text heals her packmates, not Naafiri, so I could not verify Grievous Wounds is the right early buy in this lane. Level chart untouched — all seven rows Aurora, consistent with the packet and with the 400/450-range approach tools she has to spend to reach 900-range poke.
